title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall in Florida
summary: US weather authorities are warning of "life-threatening" storm surges on the Gulf Coast due to the Category 2 hurricane. Extreme winds, rising water levels and possible tornadoes are also on the…

image.caption: Isaias brings the risk of flooding to low-lying areas of Florida's Gulf coastImage: Chris Urso/REUTERS

blocks.text: Hurricane Isaias, a Category 2 storm, has made landfall near Destin, Florida, the National Hurricane Center (NHC) said Friday evening. Destin is in the panhandle region of northern Florida.
The NHC warned of "life-threatening storm surge impacting the Gulf Coast as dangerous hurricane conditions and flash flooding spread inland."
The weather system is also bringing extreme winds, with a tornado watch issued for parts of Florida and southern Georgia.
The storm is the first hurricane of the Atlantic season and was originally a strong Category 3 storm before making landfall.

blocks.caption: The storm downed a tree in Pensacola in the Florida panhandle Image: Joe Raedle/Getty Images/AFP

blocks.text: Florida, Georgia and Alabama have all declared a State of Emergency due to the extreme weather system.
According to power outage tracking site PowerOutage.com, roughly 480,000 customers altogether were without electricity as of Friday evening in Florida, Georgia and Alabama.
